scope: Phase 3 integration: billing and trust composed into the running core on Postgres with practice, identity, settings and audit; their API, MCP tools and screens; system mail; transactional billing-trust transfers. status pass means the assigned integration behavior and all four phase cases pass and local runs of every required CI job pass at the tested revision (GitHub CI on it is pending). It is not full product acceptance: 44 of 52 criteria remain pending globally, including AC-003, AC-004, AC-006, AC-018 and AC-021 whose phase cases pass.

passed_notes.AC-005: On the running core as a non-superuser role: a withdrawal that takes the matter to -250.00 posts (201), raises open flags, queues mail in the same transaction, and the core's own delivery loop sends it over SMTP to the admin and the responsible attorney and not to staff or the accountant; a refused send stays queued with its error and goes out on a later tick.
passed_notes.AC-007: Reconciliation on the seeded ledger shows zero statement and client-sum differences; a statement 12.34 off shows exactly 12.34 on the API, the screen and the reconciliations report; a missing statement balance is refused.
passed_notes.AC-008: Invoices draft from unbilled time (accountant refused), approval is attorney-only and required before send, a send through a refusing relay leaves the invoice a draft, a send by system mail delivers the PDF to the client's address, partial and full payments update balance and status, void is refused while a payment stands, and after reversing payments the void returns the time to unbilled and it redrafts at the same total.
passed_notes.AC-009: A matter with a real unpaid invoice and a real trust balance shows both warnings on the API preview and the close screen, and closes with the warnings recorded and acknowledged.
passed_notes.AC-025: Not changed by this phase; re-verified by test-core.sh at this revision (TestAC025CustomFieldAreaCSVAndUI).
passed_notes.AC-026: A flat-fee matter is Awaiting trust funds until the fee is in trust, then Ready to apply (API and Billing / Generate screen); a short apply and an accountant apply are refused; applying posts one transfer_to_operating entry for the fee, the matter balance goes to zero, the row shows Collected, and a second apply is refused.
passed_notes.AC-030: Not changed in substance; the settings check (TestModuleClean) passes at this revision with the new core files and one enumerated fixed site (the RFC 2045 base64 line length in internal/core/mail.go).
passed_notes.AC-035: Re-verified at this revision with the billing (300) and trust (400) migrations applied (TestFreshInstallSchemaAndSeed, TestSchemaContract).

pending_notes.AC-001: Not changed by this phase; test-compose-first-run.sh passes at this revision on Linux Compose. Clean Docker Desktop (Windows/macOS) installation is release acceptance and has not run.
pending_notes.AC-002: 186 of 427 contract operations are now mounted on /api/v1 and offered on /mcp (99 before this phase), all fail closed, and the spec validates. Calendar, files, editor, Doc Tender, modules, marketplace, users and nav are not composed into the core yet.
pending_notes.AC-003: Phase case passes for billing and trust: a staff user outside a wall gets nothing from the walled matter's ledger, balances, flags, notifications, trust and billing reports, widgets, invoices, time, payments, worklist, search, screens, direct reads (404) or MCP, cannot post to it, and cannot read its audit rows; practice surfaces passed in phase 2. Files, calendar, editor, Doc Tender and module surfaces are not composed into the core, so the criterion stays pending globally.
pending_notes.AC-004: Phase case passes: the accountant reads trust accounts, ledger, balances, flags, reconciliations, invoices, invoice PDFs, payments, time, expenses, worklist and reports (API and screens), and 16 billing and trust writes are refused with 403 without changing the ledger or the audit log; MCP writes are refused. Calendar, files and module writes are not composed into the core yet, so 'can't write anything' is not demonstrated product-wide.
pending_notes.AC-006: Phase case passes: no PUT, PATCH or DELETE route or MCP tool edits a ledger entry, the non-superuser core role cannot UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE trust_ledger (core test and Compose first run), reversals require a reason, restore the balance, run once, and leave the original row unchanged. Pending globally under PONYTAIL-DEBT.md contracts ceiling 4: the owning application role keeps grant options and could GRANT UPDATE back to itself; the upgrade (a migration role owns trust_ledger) is not done.
pending_notes.AC-018: Audit half passes for billing and trust: deposits, withdrawals, token posts, invoice drafts and trust account writes carry actor and source (session vs api_token), refused writes add no audit row, and walls apply to audit reads. Backup download, S3 and network-path copies and a restore of a running core with matching record counts are not demonstrated end to end (test-backup-integration.sh covers the supervisor's restore engine only).
pending_notes.AC-020: Unchanged from phase 2: invoices in search still come from the practice mirror, which billing now feeds; file-text search is pending (files).
pending_notes.AC-021: Phase case passes on the API and the trust screens: a new flag raises the responsible attorney's unread count (and the admins', not staff), a second flag raises it again, Mark all read from the screen form clears it for that user only, a form without CSRF is refused, and another user cannot mark it read. Pending globally because PRD 7 requires the bell with the count in the shell header on every screen; the badge shows only on the trust screens (PONYTAIL-DEBT.md finance ceiling 7, ui assignment).
pending_notes.AC-023: Reopen passed in phase 2. AR aging is now billing's real report; the zero-fee exclusion over real billing data is covered in the billing package suite, not on the composed core.
pending_notes.AC-024: Unchanged from phase 2: the events table is still mutable by the application role (AC-024-F4).
pending_notes.AC-029: Unchanged; api.bulk_batch_max is now a registry setting (default 500) and a core test shows a change applies on the next bulk request.

integration_tests.TestFinanceCrossDomainTransfers: A payment into trust posts a linked deposit; Apply trust posts a transfer_to_operating entry and pays the invoice; over-apply is refused with no row; with INSERT on billing_records revoked, Apply trust fails after its trust post and the trust row and audit rows roll back with it; reversing the trust-funded payment posts the reversal and reopens the invoice; bulk posts honor api.bulk_batch_max and reject a whole batch with one invalid item; a restart on the same database keeps invoices, balances, close warnings and AR aging.
integration_tests.token_scopes: A trust:write token deposits but cannot withdraw, a bulk with one refund is refused whole, a trust:withdraw token withdraws; one bearer post counts once against security.api_rate_per_minute (regression test fails without the per-request caller memo).
integration_tests.TestFinanceCloseDuringSilentMailServer: With the delivery loop connected to a mail server that accepts and never answers, and mail.smtp_timeout_seconds at 600, App.Close returns within 10 seconds, the flag mail stays queued, and its outbox row records attempts and the error.

ci.current_revision_ci: Product CI on the pull request head reruns all six required jobs. The head adds only docs/build/reports files to 88b757c, so its product code is the tested revision's. The PR body names the head and its run. The Postgres test TestFinanceCloseDuringSilentMailServer also runs there (test-core.sh fails on a skipped Finance test).
ci.local_environment_note: Local runs used Docker postgres:17 servers, the Ubuntu PostgreSQL 18 client for the backup test (CI pins the 17 client), Go 1.22.12, and tesseract-ocr, tesseract-ocr-eng and fonts-dejavu-core installed from apt as the QA job does. The first full pass used one shared postgres:17 server (user postgres) for every suite: every command exited 0 except test-backup-integration.sh, which exited 1 (seven restore-recovery tests) because that suite expects fresh servers with the CI user and database togavsu, as its separate CI job provides; the supervisor package is not changed by this branch. Two fresh servers were created as in CI (user and database togavsu) and test-backup-integration.sh, test-core.sh and test-api.sh were rerun on them at the same revision; all exited 0 (16 of 16 restore tests passed). The recorded backup result is that rerun. At 88b757c the phase cases ran one at a time on a shared host beside another lane's suite. A local test-core.sh there hit the 15-minute package timeout in every database package, and the supervisor's timing tests failed, because the host was loaded; it is not counted. test-api.sh could not run there (python3-venv is not installed). Product CI's Core tests and API contract tests jobs are the result for that code.

mail_tab.summary: Settings, Mail tab (/settings?tab=notifications_mail) as the admin in headless Chrome: mail.smtp_timeout_seconds shows 45 with the changed badge (default 60). Pages 200, favicon 204, no console errors. 88b757c differs from 3444dda only in internal/core/finance_pg_test.go.

simplification.review: Composition reuses the packages' own seams (TrustLink, TrustEvents, Durable as Practice, Mirror and balance sink, the handlers' Routes) with no adapter layer; routing tries the three service muxes with ServeMux.Handler instead of a second route table, and MCP mounting reuses the same list. The trust mail loop reuses trust.DeliverMail and trust.SMTP; billing's mailer is the only new mail code (standard library mime/multipart, no new module); after the checkpoint review both mailers send through internal/smtpsend, net/smtp's client on a connection bound to the caller's context, also standard library. The per-request caller memo replaced a second authentication and removed integration ceiling 4; registering api.bulk_batch_max removed two package ponytails. Debt grows by 15 because the billing and trust packages' existing ponytails were not in the ledger; one new entry (the 30-second mail loop) and one routing note were added; one entry was removed.

status_reason: All four phase cases (invoice-workflows, trust-invariants, finance-permissions, trust-notices) pass with exit 0 at the tested revision, plus the cross-domain transaction test, and local runs of every required CI job exit 0. Global acceptance stays pending for AC-003, AC-004, AC-006, AC-018 and AC-021 for the reasons in pending_notes.

checkpoint_followups.summary: Commits after b59f0aa answer the review gate's findings. Every phase case and the Close and aging tests were rerun locally at 88b757c (tests above). The six required jobs, including test-core.sh and test-api.sh, are Product CI on the pull request head, whose product code is 88b757c.

changes.change: net/smtp.SendMail ignores context and sets no deadlines, so a server that accepted and then stalled held the trust mail worker and App.Close. New internal/smtpsend sends through net/smtp's client on a context-bound connection: the ctx deadline becomes the connection deadline and cancellation closes it. App.Close cancels the delivery loop and waits for it; a send cut off by cancellation still records its error on the outbox row (context.WithoutCancel).
tests: internal/core: TestFinanceCloseDuringSilentMailServer (Postgres; runs in the Core tests job)

changes.change: Each system mail send (billing and trust) is bounded by the new admin setting mail.smtp_timeout_seconds (integer, default 60, 1 to 600, Mail tab), registered under the same key and type as the contract. api/contract/settings.py, api/openapi/v1/openapi.json and the stage 1 inventory digest were regenerated. The per-pass deadline in core/finance.go was removed.

billing.firmDate converts a stored instant to the firm's calendar day (firm.time_zone). AR aging compares VoidedAt and ReversedAt through it, so a void or payment reversal late in the firm's evening counts on the firm's date, not the UTC date.
tests: internal/billing: TestARAgingDatesVoidsAndReversalsInTheFirmZone (America/Chicago; void and reversal at 03:00 UTC, checked as of the firm's day of the event and the day before; fails with UTC dates)

changes.change: TestFinanceTrustInvariants checked the outbox once, right after the fake server received both flag messages. The loop marks the row sent only after the server takes the message, so a local run under load failed there once. The test now waits for the row within the same deadline. No product change.
